hosted_verification: NOT RUN. No hosted, VM or SSH access was used and no workflow was dispatched. Hosted acceptance belongs to EVO-ALPHA-PAGES-HOSTED-ACCEPT-20261107. Everything below is functional evidence from local tests that use the real hosted record shapes given in the task brief.
write_scope: Reads and display only. No decision, postmortem, freeze order, rollback, strategy, admission or queue entry is written, cancelled, closed or retired.

change.journal: evolution/router.py emits exactly one evolution_decision row per decision; the mutation review projection is nested as mutation_review (hydrated with approval_decision/allowedActions/review_chain) and no mutation_review row is emitted. evolution/service.py: source_type=mutation_review selects decision rows carrying a projection; evolution_journal_item_is_history only classifies evolution_decision; mutation_review_count and pending_review_count count decision rows once.
change.owner_route: services/research/main.py _build_alpha_replication_entry: last_error from queue failure_reason; replay_count, last_replayed_at, revalidation_count passed through (null when absent).
change.bff_alpha_factory: console_gap/alpha_factory.py cards carry last_error, replay_count, last_replayed_at, revalidation_count and strategy_state; strategy_state is read once per distinct strategy_id through StrategiesService.get_strategy_registry_state (strategies/service.py), a StrategiesService built in core/app_factory.py over the same read surface as the strategies router, so no second registry client is created. A failed read leaves strategy_state null and sets meta.surfaces.alpha_factory_strategy_state to unavailable; cards and lanes unchanged.
change.contract: BFF_API_CONTRACT.md: one-row-per-decision rule, summary counts, new card fields, strategy_state and the alpha_factory_strategy_state surface.

acceptance.1_one_row_per_decision: test_hosted_shape_history_reports_one_row_per_decision and the rewritten view/deep-link tests in tests/test_bff_b3_evolution_journal.py; no entry_type mutation_review row appears under any view.
